rv.q: Cost n’ Mayor bring their signature dance style and energy to the Orpheum Theatre, but the concept of their show struggles to hit the emotional beats.

cn.t: Viral TikTok duo Cost n' Mayor bring their high-energy street-style choreography to the stage in this nostalgic New Year's Eve dance show that earns modest praise for its sparkle and spirit but generates mixed critical reception.

vr.q: It was everything I wanted from a costen mayor off broadway show. Like, I. I left feeling so satisfied... This is your sign. You need to come to new york city.
On the positive side, there's a lot. The choreography is the real star here.
And while I don't think this show is saying or doing anything particularly groundbreaking, it is just a really fun time.
